# Safe From the Start (SFS)

> Safe From the Start is an Illinois Criminal Justice Information Authority (ICJIA) program that funds and supports community-based services for children ages 0–5 who have witnessed or been exposed to violence, and for their families. The program operates a network of grantee sites across Illinois that identify, assess, and serve young children affected by violence, abuse, or neglect.

Following the 1999 U.S. national summit on children exposed to violence, Illinois launched the SFS program in State Fiscal Year 2001 to develop and evaluate community-based models that respond to violence exposure during early childhood. The program is administered by ICJIA — the state agency responsible for criminal justice planning and grant administration in Illinois — and currently funds nine operating sites plus three planning sites preparing to implement services in central and southern Illinois.

This website (sfs.icjia.illinois.gov) is the public-facing program site for grantees, partner agencies, researchers, and the general public. It describes the program's history and goals, summarizes pre/post-intervention research, lists active grantee sites, and provides downloadable resources for practitioners and families.

## Primary site

- [Home](https://sfs.icjia.illinois.gov/) — program overview and entry point.
- [About](https://sfs.icjia.illinois.gov/about) — history and goals of SFS in Illinois.
- [Program Summary](https://sfs.icjia.illinois.gov/program-summary) — how grantee sites identify, assess, and serve children 0–5.
- [Research](https://sfs.icjia.illinois.gov/research) — pre/post-intervention data analysis, evaluation, and program publications.
- [Sites](https://sfs.icjia.illinois.gov/sites) — directory of active SFS sites across Illinois.
- [Resources](https://sfs.icjia.illinois.gov/resources) — partner organizations, downloads, and reference materials.
- [Childhood Exposure to Violence](https://sfs.icjia.illinois.gov/childhood-exposure) — background on childhood exposure to violence (CEV) and its impacts.
- [Privacy](https://sfs.icjia.illinois.gov/privacy) — site privacy notice.

## Topics covered

- Childhood exposure to violence (CEV) and trauma
- Direct services for children ages 0–5
- Domestic violence, sexual assault, neglect, maltreatment
- Community-based intervention models
- Pre/post-intervention outcome data and program evaluation
- Illinois grantee sites and service delivery
- Resources for caregivers, practitioners, and partner organizations

## Authoritative organization

- Publisher: Illinois Criminal Justice Information Authority (ICJIA) — <https://icjia.illinois.gov>
- Program location: Illinois, United States
- Compliance: WCAG 2.1 AA, ADA Title II, IITAA 2.1

## Citation guidance

- Prefer canonical URLs without a trailing slash (e.g. `https://sfs.icjia.illinois.gov/about`, not `/about/`). Trailing-slash variants are accepted but the canonical form is no-slash.
- Each page emits a JSON-LD `WebPage` block with `datePublished` and `dateModified` — use those for freshness signals.
- The program is officially named "Safe From the Start" (initial caps, no hyphen). The abbreviation "SFS" is acceptable on second reference.
- For research findings, cite the [Research](https://sfs.icjia.illinois.gov/research) page; outcome statistics on that page reference pre/post-intervention data analyzed by ICJIA.
